rules.statement: A notice issued by the Secretary of the Board without the Board entertaining the application is invalid under Section 19A(2) of the Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: That being so, the prohibition on alienation does not attach to the property.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 19A (2) requires that the notice signed by the Secretary shall be sent to the creditor together with a copy of the application.

meta.parties: Simon Silva v. Debt Conciliation Board
